candidateDispositionNote: VF-226 moved from provisional removal to browser proof because the staged candidate now renders an explicit unverified/verified local checkout-return boundary without inferring payment from GET. The ten internal migration operator controls remain absent; ten provider-dependent controls remain truthfully unavailable.

EVF-ADMIN-CONNECTED.testTitle: admin, member, public trial, and API flows are connected

EVF-CONTROL-CATALOG.testTitle: EVF-CONTROL-CATALOG: route controls stay named, contained, and responsive

EVF-DIAGNOSTICS.testTitle: fails the case when Chromium emits an unallowlisted diagnostic

EVF-FORMS-PDF.testTitle: EVF-FORMS-PDF: authenticated bytes, fail-closed IDs, and exact Chromium viewer allowance

EVF-LANDING-RESPONSIVE.testTitle: landing navigation targets and recovery constraints

EVF-MEMBER-SCHEDULE-RECOVERY.testTitle: a lower schedule action keeps its pending and failure feedback in context

EVF-MEMBER-SCHEDULE-RESPONSIVE.testTitle: member schedule actions remain readable and responsive

EVF-MIGRATION-END-TO-END.testTitle: captures signup, intake, migration operations, gating, and readiness

EVF-MIGRATION-IMMUTABLE.testTitle: keeps the acknowledged migration snapshot immutable

EVF-MIGRATION-PERSISTED.testTitle: shows the persisted completed handoff to a fresh owner session

EVF-PROVIDER-BOUNDARIES.testTitle: EVF-PROVIDER-BOUNDARIES: unavailable controls stay truthful with zero external requests

EVF-RP16-ABSENCE.testTitle: EVF-RP16-ABSENCE: internal migration controls stay absent from the owner demo

EVF-TRIAL-RECOVERY.testTitle: keeps zero-date, populated, invalid, and server-failure states recoverable
